title: Release SemVer evidence pack (v1)
description: A strict subset of the release evidence packs that .github#2260 (ADR-0033) accepts at dccacc77: #2260's nine member names, arrays of strings, previous_version and its api_surface_inspected rule, but closed, with every member required, a canonical previous_version, string-only items and size caps. ADR 0137 lists every input #2260 accepts and v1 rejects. The pack carries no identifiers of its own and no version decision; the receipt envelope binds it by evidence_sha256, the SHA-256 of its RFC 8785 canonical JSON form (v1 packs contain no JSON numbers).
$comment: Immutable once released: any change requires a new vN directory and MANIFEST entry. Resolve every $ref from the packaged schema files through a local registry; never retrieve a $id over the network. Consumers must also reject documents larger than 4194304 UTF-8 bytes. Patterns avoid \s and guard the end of string explicitly, so ECMA-262 and Python re validators agree (Python's $ also matches before a final newline).

previous_version.description: Canonical X.Y.Z of the previous release (no v prefix, no whitespace). This is the only previous version the raters see. #2260 keeps a non-empty pack value as-is and fills a missing or empty one from `git describe --tags --abbrev=0` minus one leading v (0.0.0 without a tag), then passes that git-derived value as --previous-version, which overrides the pack for version arithmetic. The v1 producer writes that same git-derived value here, and step 2 rejects a mismatch (ADR 0137).

changelog_fragments.description: Changelog fragment texts. Multi-line text (newlines, tabs) is allowed; observations can always cite an item by index.

api_surface_inspected.description: JSON true only when the public API surface was actually inspected (#2260 tests `is True`). As in #2260, a pack that is not marked inspected must carry at least one removed/renamed/required-arg finding.

fragment.description: One evidence string. Like #2260's non-empty check (item.strip()), it must contain a character that Python's str.strip() keeps. Any other character, including newlines and tabs, is allowed.

item.description: One evidence string. Like #2260's non-empty check (item.strip()), it must contain a character that Python's str.strip() keeps. Any other character, including newlines and tabs, is allowed.

titles.description: Every commit title (commit_titles) or pull-request title (pr_titles) in the release range: all commits, merge commits included, not first-parent only. A producer never truncates or samples: if a list would exceed maxItems, an item would exceed maxLength, or the pack would exceed the 4194304-byte document cap, the producer fails closed with an error naming the member, the cap and the observed size (ADR 0137).
